name: renpy-writer
description: Screenplay-style writing environment for Ren'Py visual novels
author: GrumpyGranny

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.test:e2e: electron-vite build && esbuild src/main/ipc.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --alias:@shared=./src/shared --alias:@core=./src/core --outfile=tests/.ipc-bundle.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild src/server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@shared=./src/shared --alias:@core=./src/core --outfile=tests/.server-bundle.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild src/server/users.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@shared=./src/shared --alias:@core=./src/core --outfile=tests/.users-bundle.mjs --log-level=error && electron tests/launch-check.mjs
